The '''Aargonar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in space that was contested over by the warring [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], this area had fallen under control to the Republic.
